desc:
🌱 Cut grass, drive real mowers and grow the biggest lawn care business in town!

🚚 Start with a push mower and an old pickup truck. Tow your mower to customers' homes, cut every blade to 100% and watch perfect stripes roll across the lawn. Every job pays cash and stars.

🚜 Drive 7 mowers: push mowers, a lawn tractor, zero-turns and a stand-on
🎨 Upgrade and paint your mower at Customs
🏡 Unlock bigger neighborhoods, the park, the golf course and THE MANSION
👷 Hire a crew that mows lawns for you, even while you're offline
🏢 Build your HQ from an empty lot into a headquarters
📣 Put up flyers, yard signs and a billboard so customers call you
💎 Find hidden treasures in the long grass
🍄 Collect garden gnomes that ride on your mower
⚡ Growth Spurt every 20 minutes: lawns grow back and jobs pay +50%
👥 Mow with friends for bonus cash

📅 Come back every day: your regular customers pay +50% and daily rewards are waiting!
